captain:AC0001.name: Alliance Federation Captain
captain:AC0001.text: Interactive Alliance captain card. Provides up to 3 Talent slots and 2 flexible Tech/Weapon/Crew slots; choose cards to match your XP unlocks. Edit your captain name and spend XP on the imported card in Tabletop Simulator. The tracker follows the captain name and skill. XP is tracked separately from the builder's fleet points.
